verdict.summary: Round 4 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The diagnostic remains confined to the already-failed query/update parse path, preserves the failed SPARQL byte-for-byte, and cannot alter execution. The scanner now handles dotted PN_PREFIX runs and the broader PN_LOCAL forms without turning valid prefixed-name data into keyword hints; the focused unit tests and the public-path CanaryFailed integration regressions exercise those boundaries with an unrelated parse failure. The keyword table has sortedness and vendored-grammar drift checks, arbitrary-input properties cover bounded/deduplicated well-formed output, and the public error/API documentation consistently describes suggestions as optional and non-rewriting. This materially matches round 3's clean finding set, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
